title: Bullom So language — Grokipedia
text: Bullom So possesses a consonant inventory of approximately 25 phonemes, characteristic of many Mel languages within the Niger-Congo family. These include a series of stops, fricatives, nasals, liquids, and glides, with notable prenasalized stops and labial-velar articulations.
